propositions: The close precheck scans all reachable commit messages and calls the shared resolver for every extracted reference, causing unrelated historical commit ambiguity errors to print to stderr.
Ambiguous short-prefix resolver errors are printed even when the precheck successfully closes the target ticket using a full ID, indicating the diagnostics are from unrelated historical candidates.
The precheck only needs to know whether a reference matches accepted target IDs, but the resolver emits user-facing diagnostics for all ambiguous matches regardless of context.
Later valid full-ID commit references must still be detected even when earlier history contains an ambiguous short prefix.
